standard_prerequisites.name: The two first-order operators on the cylinder and the compact side
standard_prerequisites.statement: The operators D_C^+/- on L^2(S_C^+/-) with domains W^2_D(S_C^+/-; P or 1-P) and the model operators tilde D_C^+/- on L^2(tilde S_C^+) with domains W^2_{tilde D_C}(tilde S_C^+; P or 1-P), together with the projection P of eq def P.
standard_prerequisites.use: The pairs of operators the proposition relates; declared as the article's standing notation, no external stub beyond the operator-display stubs.

core_obligations: State the five-part criterion (statement lines 1012-1028): (a) invertibility at infinity in the sense of eq D inv infty holds if and only if there are b_0 > 0 and u >= a with the uniform lower bound on tilde D_C s over compactly supported smooth sections supported in (u, infinity); (b) eq DC+ is invertible iff eq D0+ P is; (c) eq DC- is invertible iff eq D0- 1-P is; (d) D_C^- D_C^+ on L^2(S_C^+) with domain W^2_D(S_C^+; P) is self-adjoint iff tilde D_C^- tilde D_C^+ on L^2(tilde S_C^+) with domain W^2_{tilde D_C}(tilde S_C^+; P) is; (e) the analogous statement for D_C^+ D_C^- with domain W^2_D(S_C^-; 1-P).

Reproduce the correspondence argument (proof lines 1030-1053): part (a) from Lemmas T isom and T Dpsi; the trace identity (Ts)|_N = Phi(a) s|_N gives P(s|_N) = 0 iff P(Ts|_N) = 0 and likewise for 1-P; hence T and T circ tau are unitary isomorphisms of the four domains W^1/W^2 with the P and 1-P boundary conditions (eq T W2), using the definition of P to check that T circ tau preserves the boundary conditions; under these isomorphisms the operator pairs of parts (b)-(e) correspond, again using Lemmas T isom, T Dpsi and D0pm.
proof_roadmap: Derive part (a) from the two isomorphism lemmas (proof lines 1031).
Establish the unitary isomorphisms eq T W2 from the trace identity and the definition of P (proof lines 1033-1050).
Conclude the correspondences of parts (b)-(e) (proof lines 1052).
difficulty_reason: H2: 24-line proof - the correspondence argument is a single verbatim chain (trace identity, four unitary isomorphisms, transfer of the five properties); the statement is the author's own five-part enumerate carried verbatim.
